title: Wakeful and sleep-like states in subdural ECoG (Pahwa et al., 2015): 4 patients, 64-channel grids
description: Subdural electrocorticography (ECoG) recordings from four patients with intractable epilepsy, acquired with 8x8 electrode grids over left frontal, temporal and parietal cortex during clinical monitoring. For each patient, two wakeful and two sleep-like epochs were identified from video and audio of natural behaviour, with no task. The data support work on detecting wake and sleep-like states for future ECoG brain-computer interface applications.
methods_description: Subdural 64-channel ECoG grids recorded during clinical epilepsy monitoring, with only the amplifiers' 0.1 Hz hardware high-pass applied. Wakeful and sleep-like epochs were identified from video and audio of natural behaviour. Sampling rates were taken from the release README (256 Hz for subject A, 512 Hz for subjects B, C and D). The released MATLAB matrices were converted to BrainVision float32 format with identical values.
